properties.name: Geary St and Blvd, Market St to 10th Ave
properties.geometry_method: Along today's Geary Street and Geary Boulevard centerline from Market Street to 10th Avenue (5847 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); checked on USGS San Francisco North 1:24,000 (1950).

sources.note: December 28, 1912: "On that first day, Muni's A line operated from Kearny & Market, on Geary and 10th Ave. to Fulton St. at Golden Gate Park, with the B line providing shuttle service on Geary from 10th to 33rd Aves."
December 29, 1956: "Last day of the B streetcar line on Geary"

properties.notes: Muni's own track, laid in 1911-12 after the Geary Street, Park & Ocean cable line on the same street.

properties.name: The Embarcadero, Market St to Washington St
properties.geometry_method: Along today's The Embarcadero centerline from Market Street to Washington Street (224 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); checked on USGS San Francisco North 1:24,000 (1950).

sources.note: December 11, 1913: the city buys the Presidio & Ferries RR and "begins Muni streetcar service on the company's line", then running "from the Ferry Building, on The Embarcadero, Jackson (westbound) and Washington (eastbound), Columbus Ave., Union, Larkin, Vallejo, Franklin, then back to Union, Baker, Greenwich, and a right of way in The Presidio." It "was named the E line in February 1915."

properties.notes: The Presidio & Ferries' track to the Ferry Building, which Muni bought in 1913; when it opened isn't sourced yet.
